title: Oppression by the Ammonites and Philistines
summary: The LORD sells Israel into the hands of the Philistines and of the children of Ammon; Ammon vexes Gilead eighteen years (Judg 10:6–9), and Israel is in the hand of the Philistines forty years (Judg 13:1).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (F. N. Jones): 1170 BC (no higher-tier year available). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: "VEXED & OPPRESSED BY AMMON AND PHILISTIA" 18 years, 1170 BC to 1152 BC
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
chronologies.note: Jones dates the 40 years of Philistine dominion (Judg 13:1) separately, 1141 BC to 1101 BC ("THE DAYS of the PHILISTINES 40 YEARS of DOMINION").

chronologies.date: 2799a AM, 1206 BC (fifth oppression, Philistines and Ammonites, 18 years)
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §367 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: Ussher puts the 40 years of Philistine oppression (Judg 13:1) later, from Abdon's death and Eli's judgeship: §378, 2848a AM, 1157 BC ("the Israelites' sixth oppression").

chronologies.date: "2861 - Beginning of Philistine oppression in the South and Ammonite oppression in the Center and North (Jud. 10:5-7). Likely births of Samson, Samuel, Obed, and Jephthah's daughter."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52
chronologies.note: 2001 revision. Jordan's 1991 list (BC 3:8) has an earlier year; see the second Jordan entry. "2860 - End of the 300 years of Judges 11:26." p. 40: "the Philistine oppression in the south and the Ammonite oppression in the east commenced at the same time"; east: 18 + 6 + 7 + 10 + 8 = 49 years; south: 20 + 20 (Samson) = 40.

chronologies.date: "2835 - Death of Jair, beginning of Philistine oppression in the South and Ammonite oppression in the Center and North (Jud. 10:5-7). Births of Samson and Samuel."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 5:2: "The Ammonites oppressed Israel in the Center and North beginning in 2835".
